notes: 2605.18401 SkillsVote (status conflict: sol needs_fulltext vs son55 reviewed). MATERIAL RULING: reviewed. The missing Appendix 12 (PDF Appendix G) prompt bodies were read from the page images (pp. 45, 56–63, 71). They are implementation detail. The core-claim evidence (Tables 1–4, Fig. 5–6, §8 protocol) is in the pinned text or in the figures (pp. 9–10). The prompts confirm the text's description of what each mode sees: online attribution gets only task-level verifier counts; offline oracle mode adds solution/, verifier/tests/ and test-stdout; the skill-creator baseline gets the same verifier counts and ground-truth context (p. 71). Appendix 12 does not carry core-claim evidence, so no dual-seat a3 is required for material reasons. Because sol deferred all eight items, this score rests on son55 plus Opus re-check (as with SE-GPT in r01b). An optional sol a3 (text + page images) is advisable only if the controller requires two independent seat ratings for this paper. Final 63.75 (= son55; every item re-checked). Opus corrected son55's 'no de-attribution ablation': skill-creator is that ablation, with the same verifier signal. Its gains are mixed: 0.0/+5.2/+1.9 on TB2, +1.7/+0.3/+3.8 on SWE-Pro, with no variance.

2605.18729 Robo-Cortex (status conflict: sol needs_fulltext vs son55 reviewed). MATERIAL RULING: reviewed, following the SE-GPT precedent. The only gap is 'Additional implementation details are provided in the supplementary material', which is author-side material outside the arXiv v1 record. Every result the claims rest on (Tables 1–3, the Fig. 4 numbers in §4.3, the real-world 4/10) is in the pinned text. The supplement could only move X (thresholds/prompts) and E.cost (if it held compute numbers). X=2 rests on design facts stated in the main text: no retention gate or rollback, an unstated source for the static memory, and online rewriting that harms the transferred prior. E.cost is not_reported with the search scope recorded. If the controller later obtains the supplement, re-dispatch only those two items. Final 43.75 (= son55). Opus additions, not changing ratings: (i) the Fig. 4 round-1 numbers coincide with differently labelled Table 3 rows ('on-split' = 'w/ manual heur.', 'from-scratch' = 'w/ manual heur. + update'); (ii) IGNav SR values imply varying episode denominators (144/140/143/142 across Table 1 methods; 72/71/70/68 within splits), i.e. unexplained dropped episodes. son55's 'all SR are multiples of 1/72' is wrong (36.62 = 26/71).

2605.19576 Library Drift (Δ15): final 47.5 (= sol). The five disputed items go to sol after reading the text. G 2: the gap premise that unbounded accumulation causes drift is never reproduced (A1 is injection-off, A4 is over-governance). The paper's own A3 makes the authoring prior the single most valuable component, which contradicts its 'not the author; the librarian' framing. X 2: rollback exists only in the hyperparameter table. Table 1's A1 row is inconsistent with the stated mechanism: 42 skills synthesised and 15 retired with 0 critic calls and 0 injections, although synthesis needs critic-verdict clusters and retirement needs n(s) ≥ N_min trials. E.measurement 2: Eq. 2's 'contribution' is not a contribution, and the A1 row is inconsistent. E.holdout 1: the router injects on the 40 eval tasks every round and Eq. 2 draws on 'capsules where s was injected', with no train-only restriction. Those 40 tasks are reused across 100 rounds and 9 conditions. E.cost 2: the 14.5k-call tally omits the per-task LLM router-gate calls. Shared items (M 2, E.causality 2, E.statistics 2) confirmed. RS → assumption_audit_and_pivot/C11 (budgeted retention rule pivoted from append-only to outcome-driven retirement, with a certificate whose failure mode matches Prop. 1) plus supporting controlled_diagnostic_design/C02. adapt_via_conditioning is not kept. Domain → H30 + H32 + H31.

2605.21240 APEX (Δ10): final 65.0, between the seats (sol 60 / son55 70). G 3 → son55: the bottleneck is concrete, with a same-backbone diagnostic, and the nearest neighbours (Reflexion/EvoTest/ACE) are run as baselines. X 2 → sol: Appendix C adds skipped milestones to a 'per-episode completed set', which contradicts §4.1's actual-achievement eligibility unless the sets are separate. Completion is self-reported, and LLM-proposed nodes face no gate or rollback. E.cost 3 → son55: episode/step budgets are equal and WebArena API dollars are given for all six methods. Shared items (M 3, E.measurement 3, E.causality 3, E.holdout 2, E.statistics 1) confirmed. The Zork1 70.2 vs 73.0 same-config inconsistency is charged once, to E.statistics (A2). RS → reframe_as_solvable_object (sub null); sol's supporting adapt_via_conditioning is not kept. Domain → H01 + H04 + H29.

2605.21810 Trace2Skill (Δ1.25): final 52.5 (= sol). E.holdout 0 → sol: the hidden verifier is the selection signal (pass-dominant SelectQ), the in-rollout feedback source, and the evaluation. Results come from the optimisation rollouts themselves, and no frozen skill or held-out task is evaluated (A2: oracle signal → E.holdout). E.statistics 2 → sol (A2 tier 2: per-task repeated-run pass counts with denominators, no cross-EA-run variance). Both seats' E.causality 1 is confirmed and strengthened by Opus: 'Solved/8' compares ≥1 pass in 80 rollouts (C3/C4) with ≥1 in 4 (C1/C2), and C1's 0/32 is the selection set (96 = 24×4 baseline rollouts picked the 8 tasks). Both seats' evidence_level 'task' is correct (EVIDENCE rule 2).
